stream_cdc.description: An np2hw stream with its framing flags crossing between two unrelated clocks: np2hw's stream_cdc, on its dual-clock FIFO. A link reset must assert both sides; the pointer paths are constrained by np2hw's own file, scoped to the FIFO.

A.description: The FIFO holds 2**A beats: it absorbs jitter, it is not a rate adapter.

inputs.name: wrst
inputs.description: The write side's reset, active high.

inputs.name: rrst
inputs.description: The read side's reset, active high.

frame_cdc.description: stream_cdc for a stream that carries its frame's size: each frame's width and height cross beside its samples, published from the moment the frame's first beat is presented until the next frame's is. A link reset must assert both sides; the pointer paths are constrained by np2hw's own file, scoped to the FIFO.

A.description: The FIFO holds 2**A beats: it absorbs jitter, it is not a rate adapter.

SA.description: The size crossing holds 2**SA frames' sizes; it fills only when that many frames are in the sample crossing at once.

inputs.name: wrst
inputs.description: The write side's reset, active high.

inputs.name: in_frame_width
inputs.description: The width of the frame whose first beat is going in.

inputs.name: rrst
inputs.description: The read side's reset, active high.

outputs.name: out_frame_width
outputs.description: The width of the frame being presented: the next frame's from the moment its first beat is.
